<div class="card-body">
'''Emergency Deployment''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">緊急発進</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵が、こちらの２倍より大きな戦闘力を持つ場所で戦闘を宣言した時に使う。リザーブデッキからカードを３枚まで引ける。引いたカードが、キャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、アイテム、武器であれば、コストなしで好きなところに配備する。それ以外のカードの場合、ロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-244o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タイ・ファイターは、通常はハンガー・デッキの巨大なラックに停泊している。強力なトラクター・ビームで宇宙空間に放出され、素早く展開、交戦できるのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Emergency Launch.

'''Card text:''' Use when the opponent initiates a battle at a location where their power is more than twice yours. You may draw up to three cards from your Reserve Deck. Deploy any character, starship, vehicle, item, or weapon drawn wherever you choose at no cost. Other cards drawn are lost.

'''Lore:''' TIE fighters normally dock in enormous racks on hangar decks. Powerful tractor beams launch them into space so they can deploy and engage quickly.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Emergency Deployment]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
